name: Operational Analytics Dashboard
prompt: I need an operational dashboard to track our daily active users (DAU) and monthly recurring revenue (MRR). Show me a top row of KPI cards for total users, revenue, churn rate, and active sessions. Below that, include a line chart showing 30-day user growth, and a bar chart showing revenue by region.

thought_process.interpretation: The user requires an operational dashboard for an Operations Manager or Business Analyst persona to monitor DAU and MRR. I will follow the 'Process Monitor' archetype, prioritizing high-level KPI cards and trend-based visualizations. The dashboard will utilize a 4-column KPI grid followed by a mixed-grid layout for temporal and categorical analysis.
assumed_from_scratch: Theme context provider/logic to demonstrate both light and dark modes mentioned in the visual spec
Date granularity toggle logic (functional as requested)
thought_process.skill_suggestions: A specific 'DashboardHeader' skill could be created to standardize the placement of global filters and page titles across different archetypes.
